text:
The noble gases are in Group VIII of the Periodic Table.
Which statement explains why noble gases are unreactive?
A
They all have eight electrons in their outer shells.
B
They all have full outer shells.
C
They are all gases.
D
They are all monoatomic.

options.label: A
options.text: They all have eight electrons in their outer shells.

options.label: B
options.text: They all have full outer shells.
